title: Monthly Money Review Setup
subtitle: Set up a Claude project once. Then each month: paste the tracker's snapshot, review the slide deck together, and ask it anything, as you would a financial advisor.
intro: **How it works:** the tracker makes a text summary of your finances (the snapshot). In the project, a skill turns it into a short slide deck, then answers your questions using your own numbers.
**Privacy:** the snapshot holds your real amounts but no account numbers. It goes only into your own Claude project.

**Which month it covers:** always the last full month. Run it in the first days of a month and the deck reviews the month that just ended, with its real numbers. Averages appear only as small comparisons.

steps.text: Save the skill. In the Claude Code chat, find the file **monthly-money-review.skill** and click **Save skill**. If there is no button, download the file and add it the same way you added your other skills.
steps.done: **monthly-money-review** appears in your list of skills and is switched on.

steps.text: In Claude, create a new project and name it **Monthly Money Review**.
Open the project's **instructions** and paste in the text below.
steps.done: The project's instructions show the pasted text.

steps.text: In the Sheet, run **Finance Tracker → Bank feed → Sync now**, then review anything waiting on **Import Staging**, so the month is complete.
Run **Finance Tracker → Copy financial snapshot for AI…** and copy the text it shows.
Open a **new chat in the project**, paste the snapshot, and send it.
steps.done: Claude builds a slide deck of about 10 slides and gives a three-line summary.

steps.text: Open the deck and go through it together. The last slides list decisions to make and next month's to-dos.
Ask anything: "Can we afford…?", "Should we pay the card or save?", "How long until the car is paid off?"
steps.done: Each answer starts from your numbers, gives a recommendation and shows the arithmetic.

steps.text: When you are done, say **wrap up**.
steps.done: Claude lists the decisions you made and the to-dos. Put the to-dos on the tracker's **To-Do & Reminders** tab.

steps.text: Add this month's snapshot (and the deck, if you like) to the **project's files**.
steps.done: Next month's review can compare against it.
